item.title: Eutelsat’s 5G NTN push is bigger than one satellite programme
item.summary: The European Commission has reached an implementation agreement with the SpaceRISE consortium, Eutelsat, Hispasat and SES, to move IRIS², Europe's sovereign satellite programme, from design into full industrial execution. The post Eutelsat’s 5G NTN push is bigger than one satellite programme appeared first on Capacity .
